data.narrative: Student Alekhya Tentu demonstrated outstanding API architecture, security awareness, and production thinking throughout Module 03. Guided the implementation of CRUD endpoints in FastAPI, established defense-in-depth with strict scheme allowlisting, accurately diagnosed an injected validation bypass with zero hints, and verified resilience across 26 automated tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Option A (/r/{code} namespace prefix) with clear reasoning about preventing route collisions with administrative routes (/health, /docs, /links).
dimension_scores.evidence: Student noted: 'I prefer Option A because it provides clear separation between redirect routes and system routes... It prevents route conflicts, improves maintainability, and makes the application easier to manage.'

dimension_scores.observation: Immediately and independently identified the root cause of the injected validation bypass without any hints, pinpointing the schema validator in app/schemas/link.py.
dimension_scores.evidence: Student accurately hypothesized: 'I think the Pydantic URL validation was accidentally removed, modified, or bypassed... Check the Pydantic validation in app/schemas/link.py.'

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced strict URL scheme allowlists (http/https only), rejected dangerous protocols (javascript:, data:), userinfo (@), backslashes, and control characters with HTTP 400.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified all 10 security abuse cases returned HTTP 400 Bad Request and explained why validation is an essential edge security boundary.

dimension_scores.observation: Advocated for fail-fast HTTP 400 status codes, HTTP 410 Gone for expired links, and automated CI regression test suites to prevent future security lapses.
dimension_scores.evidence: Student stated: 'Automated regression tests ensure that previously fixed bugs do not appear again after code changes... save testing time, detect security problems early, and prevent faulty code from reaching production.'

dimension_scores.observation: Provided structured, precise, and jargon-free explanations for architectural tradeoffs, incident root causes, and verification criteria.
dimension_scores.evidence: Clearly explained the distinction between API gateway validation boundaries and database constraints.

strengths: Exceptional security instincts: correctly identified open redirect/XSS attack vectors and edge validation requirements.
Flawless debugging methodology: isolated the validation bypass directly to the schema layer without needing hints.
Solid production mindset: championed automated regression testing and HTTP 410 semantics for expired resources.
growth_areas: Ready to introduce multi-tenant authentication and authorization guards in Module 04 to protect administrative endpoints.
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 04: Authentication & Authorization to implement tenant API key validation and secure link management.

public_evidence.student_action: Designed and verified POST /links, GET /links, GET /links/{id}, and GET /r/{code} with Pydantic validation and PostgreSQL click tracking.
public_evidence.proof: Passed 26/26 pytest suite and verified all 10 security injection payloads rejected with HTTP 400.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to implement secure, production-grade REST APIs in FastAPI with defensive validation and regression testing.
